INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

3. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.

4. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

5. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

7. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.

8. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Audial- Visual Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.

2. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.

6. D — CPU

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

9. B — Information and Communication Technology

10. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Audial- Visual Creation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Emerging Trends in ICT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Artificial Intelligence; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
